selection_rule: all three original UAV capture_0/1/2 with actual exposure prior; no first/last/thumbnail fallback

timing_environment.scope: one process synchronous whole matcher; wall-clock includes IPM/query SIFT/12-template BF/RANSAC/geometry; one call only, not concurrency/ROS scheduling evidence

world_transform: Use exposure prior UAV pose quaternion/position; body [forward,left,.012-body_z] rotated to world; never use planned observation pose.
limitations: v23 completed the route and captured three original increasing-stamp frames; no official recognition or scoring claim.
Each geometric candidate is compared after matching with all physical candidate rectangles and the actual current first ID.
Extrinsics/ground model and ID-to-model map remain candidate assumptions; no official category or task binding truth.
Timing is local CPU single-thread synchronous evidence, not a safe ROS callback budget or worker concurrency benchmark.
